Credential brute-forcing is trying many username and password combinations until one works.

credential theft technique
Credential theft is the stealing of usernames, passwords, tokens, or other login information.
credentials concept
Credentials are login details or access tokens that prove a user or system is allowed to access something.
criminal hacking concept

Criminal justice information is sensitive data used by law-enforcement and justice agencies, such as case, arrest, or identification records.
Criminal Network concept
A group of people working together to commit crimes.
Criminals concept
Criminals are people or groups who commit acts that break the law.
critical infrastructure concept
Critical infrastructure refers to essential systems and services that societies and organizations depend on.

Critical remote code execution is a severe security flaw that lets an attacker run code on a system from afar.

Essential medical treatments that patients may depend on for health or survival.

A critical vulnerability is a very serious security flaw that can cause major damage if exploited.
cross-origin payment iframe concept

Cruciferra is a threat-actor or campaign name referenced in security reporting.

Cryptocurrency Addresses concept
Public identifiers used to send and receive funds on a cryptocurrency network.

Companies that provide services involving digital currencies or blockchain-based assets.

Programs that use computer processing power to help create or validate cryptocurrency transactions, sometimes without the owner's permission.

cryptocurrency wallet addresses concept

Customer accounts are user records and logins that let customers access a company's services.
customer data concept
Customer data is information a company keeps about its customers, such as names, contact details, or purchase history.

cyber concept

The ability of an organization or society to withstand, recover from, and continue operating during digital disruptions.
Cyber and Specialist Operations Command organization

cyber incidents concept
Cyber incidents are events that threaten or harm computer systems, networks, or data.
cyber operations concept
Activities conducted in cyberspace including espionage, sabotage, or defense, typically by state-sponsored groups.
cyber resilience concept

An official list of people or organizations subject to penalties for alleged malicious cyber activity.

cyber threats concept

cyberattack concept

cyberattacks concept

A threat-actor group referenced in security reporting, known for targeting industrial and critical-infrastructure systems.
cyberespionage technique

Cybersecurity concept
Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting computers, networks, software, and data from digital attacks or misuse.

cybersecurity incident concept

Data access means the ability to view, use, change, or retrieve information from a system.

data categories concept

A United Kingdom government organization that provides science and technology support for defense and security.
defenders concept

Scheduled periods when refrigeration equipment melts accumulated frost or ice.

The activities and institutions through which people choose representatives and make public decisions, such as elections.

The process of releasing software, configuration changes, or services into a live environment.

Blood collected from volunteers for transfusions and medical treatment.

Doppelgänger threat-actor
A Russian-linked influence operation known for using fake news websites and social-media accounts to spread misleading content.

e-commerce concept

egress allowlist technique

The company behind Elasticsearch and the Elastic Stack, providing search, observability, and security solutions.

Electrical power used by homes, businesses, and essential public services.
email access concept

Email addresses are the unique names people use to send and receive email, such as user@example.com.

A service used to send large numbers of emails, such as newsletters or announcements.

emails concept

A machine-speed intrusion is a cyberattack carried out or accelerated by automation so it happens much faster than a person could act.

mail server tool

Mailboxes concept

Management Systems concept

manual review concept

monitoring system concept

A system in which multiple AI agents work together or divide tasks among themselves.

A login security method that requires more than one proof of identity, such as a password and a phone code.
myanmar other

Mythos 5 is a named AI model or model version referenced in reporting.

public services concept
